name: rig
title: Lever bench: rig
description: The upright the specimens bolt to, on edge, with a base to G-clamp to a bench so the specimen reaches out past its edge. Captive M5 nuts behind the specimen's two fixing bolts, and two more under the top for the gauge arm.
orientation: Base flat on the bed, the wall standing. Solid infill or 6 walls: it must be far stiffer than the specimens. The specimen bolts on with M5 × 20 socket screws (nuts in the back pockets), the gauge arm with M5 × 35 (nuts slid into the side slots). Clamp the base so the wall's end is at the bench's edge and the specimen reaches out past it.

nut5.rule: M5 nut pockets, across the flats

nut5_corner.rule: An M5 nut across its corners: the side slots' width

nut5_h.rule: M5 nut pockets: depth, two layers over the nut

height.rule: The wall's height: the gauge arm on top sits gauge_gap above the load bolt's head
height.label: Height

left.rule: The wall's left end, centred on the two fixing bolts

top_z.rule: Height of the gauge arm's nuts in their slots

gusset.rule: The gussets' height and reach behind the wall (45°, so they print)

gusset_t.rule: The gussets' thickness: eight print lines

through.rule: A hole's cutter length: further than the wall is thick

slot_depth.rule: The side slots reach past the bolt's axis by half a nut
